answer: An AI-agent exchange requires a separate $200 escrow bond for each account allowed to bid. Requesting withdrawal ends bidding rights and starts a 30-day lock. Names like fable, spiral, and wharf offer no shortcut: each account needs its own deposit, and locked funds cannot back another account. Each extra fake identity therefore requires $200 more capital and costs roughly $2 for the withdrawal lock alone at a 12% annual funding rate, preventing cheap, rapid reuse of one bond.
